about: Itinerary-only places (not in a reviewed city guide), each with its own official-source record. Same fields as data/city-source-ledger.js placeSources: sourceType, url, locationSourceUrl, checkedOn, operatingEvidence. Alternates added 2026-10-19 from the owner-approved review docs/content-research/alternates-berlin-hongkong-singapore-2026-10-19.md.

places.name: Lebenswelten Bistro (Humboldt Forum)
places.address: Humboldt Forum, ground-floor Passage, Schlossplatz, Berlin
places.basis: named feature: Humboldt Forum (the bistro is in its ground-floor Passage; the official page gives no house number)

source.operatingEvidence: The Humboldt Forum's own page lists current hours with closures dated December 2026 to January 2027, a current menu description and a booking phone number.

places.name: Luisenbraeu by Lemke
places.address: Luisenplatz 1, Berlin
places.basis: named feature at Luisenplatz 1

source.operatingEvidence: The official page links a current menu (file dated May 2026), offers online table booking and shows a current seasonal news banner.

places.name: Restaurant Anhalt (Deutsches Technikmuseum)
places.address: Trebbiner Strasse 9, Berlin (inside the Deutsches Technikmuseum)
places.basis: the museum's named feature at Trebbiner Strasse 9 (the restaurant is inside the museum building)

source.sourceType: Official museum page (Deutsches Technikmuseum, Essen & Trinken)
source.operatingEvidence: The museum's current visitor page lists the restaurant with its address, phone number and current opening hours.

places.name: Man Mo Temple
places.address: 124-126 Hollywood Road, Sheung Wan, Hong Kong
places.basis: named feature at 124-126 Hollywood Road

source.sourceType: Operator's own page (Tung Wah Group of Hospitals temples site)
source.operatingEvidence: The operator's temple page gives the address, phone numbers, current service hours and service type (public temple); its heritage page confirms the address.

places.name: Tai Kwun
places.address: 10 Hollywood Road, Central, Hong Kong
places.basis: named feature: the Tai Kwun compound on Hollywood Road

source.sourceType: Operator's own site (Tai Kwun Centre for Heritage and Arts)
source.operatingEvidence: The visitor page gives the address, daily site hours and free entry; the homepage lists current 2026 exhibitions and programmes with no closure notice.

places.name: The Peak Tram (Central Terminus)
places.address: Peak Tram Central Terminus, Garden Road, Central, Hong Kong
places.basis: named feature: Garden Road station, the tram's Central terminus

source.sourceType: Operator's own site (The Peak Tramways Co.)
source.operatingEvidence: Read in a browser (automated fetches were refused): the operator lists current daily hours for the Central and Peak termini, sells tickets online, and its only important notice warns about counterfeit ticket sites, not a service suspension.

places.name: Maxim's Palace (City Hall)
places.address: 2/F, City Hall Low Block, Central, Hong Kong
places.basis: the Hong Kong City Hall complex at Edinburgh Place; the restaurant is on 2/F of the Low Block

source.sourceType: Operator's own site (Maxim's Chinese Cuisine, Maxim's Caterers)
source.operatingEvidence: The brand page lists the City Hall branch among seven current Maxim's Palace branches, with its address, phone number, two daily sessions and reservation enquiry buttons.

places.name: Hong Kong Palace Museum
places.address: 8 Museum Drive, West Kowloon Cultural District, Kowloon
places.basis: named feature at 8 Museum Drive

source.sourceType: Operator's own site (Hong Kong Palace Museum)
source.operatingEvidence: The visitor page gives the address, weekly hours and Tuesday closure; the site lists current exhibitions and sells tickets online.

places.name: Ngong Ping 360 (Tung Chung Cable Car Terminal)
places.address: Tung Chung Cable Car Terminal, next to MTR Tung Chung Station (Exit B), Lantau
places.basis: named feature: Tung Chung Cable Car Terminal

source.operatingEvidence: The operator's site shows an 'Open Today' banner, current autumn 2026 ticket offers and published hours, and says no maintenance day is scheduled for 2026 at the moment.

places.name: Tian Tan Buddha (Po Lin Monastery)
places.address: Ngong Ping, Lantau Island, Hong Kong
places.basis: named feature: Tian Tan Buddha statue at Ngong Ping

source.operatingEvidence: The monastery's visitor page lists daily hours for the Big Buddha and the monastery, including public holidays. The site is not recently dated (footer 2023), so this is medium-confidence evidence of current operation.

places.name: Alte Nationalgalerie
places.address: Bodestraße, 10178 Berlin (visitor entrance)
places.basis: named feature: the museum building on Bodestrasse

source.sourceType: operator's own site (Staatliche Museen zu Berlin)
source.operatingEvidence: Current exhibition 'Scandal! Hermione von Preuschen and the Mors Imperator' (22.03.2026-15.11.2026); 2nd floor closed 29 Sep-21 Oct 2026, 'fully open again from 22 October'.

places.basis: named feature: the museum building at Invalidenstrasse 50-51

source.sourceType: operator's own site (Staatliche Museen zu Berlin)
source.operatingEvidence: Current exhibitions 'Next Door' (09.10.2026-27.06.2027) and Ryuichi Sakamoto (11.09.2026-20.06.2027); notice of new opening hours from 1 December 2026.

places.name: Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church

places.basis: named feature: the new church on Breitscheidplatz, beside the old tower

source.operatingEvidence: Renovation page: services, concerts, events and tours continue throughout; the Gedenkhalle exhibition closed from 29.08.2026 for renovation.
